description: Commissioners raised concerns about the impact of large-scale wind and solar construction traffic on county-maintained roads and bridges (heavy loads, vehicles exceeding weight restrictions) after TransAlta announced and then dropped plans for a wind farm in the county; the county wanted road-use agreements and oversight in place before any wind or solar developer (including Orsted, whose Badger Wind Farm spans McIntosh and Logan counties) could use county roads for construction. Extended as of 2026-06-01 per the McIntosh Democrat; long-form reporting by Canary Media (2026-09) and Mother Jones (2026-09) independently describes McIntosh County as having 'adopted a one-year moratorium on new wind projects' in April 2026 -- a description that may refer to this same road-use moratorium (simplified) or to a distinct action not otherwise located in this pass.
